collision: SL-first; adverse gap stop, capped favorable target gap; no favorable unknown extrema credit
counterfactual_control_semantics: matched LONG/SHORT are paired event-study episodes, may overlap across episodes; not funded portfolios; unconditional controls and candidates enforce no overlapping same-symbol positions
exit_timing: stop/target event reported at containing minute end as conservative holding/funding proxy; intraminute actual timing unknown
features: exact25 closed hourly bars from contiguous authentic1m; ATR24/SMA24 and signed24h return; no derivatives used as signals

fees.fee_semantics: fee applied to modeled adverse entry/exit prices; spread and slippage separately charged; no discounts or fee rebates
fees.funding_actual: public recorded event rates and intervals, charges where entry_ms<settlement_ms<=exit_ms; direction*rate positive charges, negative benefits conservatively discarded
fees.funding_missing: uniform whole-campaign PROXY_STRESS_ONLY if any symbol-month absent, checksum invalid or schedule gap >8h; base adverse 0.0004 and stress 0.0008 at every UTC 00/08/16h settlement
fees.funding_missing_verdict: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; do not treat proxy-only historical funding as measured cost
fees.funding_price_proxy: quantity*max(raw entry,settlement minute high) as funding notional; actual mark price not available, explicitly proxy not measured payment
fees.funding_stress: 2*max(adverse recorded rate,0.0004) per verified settlement; no favorable funding assumed
fees.latency_stress: entry delayed one extra minute, same decisions/maxhold/partition rules; no new signals
fees.liquidity_stress: same decisions/trades, participation <=0.0001; otherwise unfilled, no reoptimization
fees.neighborhood: NOT_RUN; no candidate tuning or extra strategies

funding_timestamp_handling: exact public calculation milliseconds preserved; jitter makes exact cadence incomplete, activating frozen uniform adverse fallback

independent_review.access: read-only, no market archives or empirical outcomes inspected
independent_review.post_review_admission_hardening: unknown cache/output path denied before metadata reads, decisive negative test passed

invalid_funding_checksum_interpretation: HARD_STOP wins over conflicting fallback phrase; no unverified-rate reuse. No invalid checksum observed
liquidity: latest completed minute available at entry under60s lag (entry-120s minute); entry-minute volume only conservative no-fill veto
observed_equity: fixed-notional realized PnL curve, not self-financing/live MTM account

risk.MFE_MAE: full extrema on completed pre-exit minutes; stop minute MFE excludes unknown pre-stop extremes; TP minute MAE uses conservative full-minute adverse excursion
risk.collision: SL-first in same minute; gaps worse stop min(stop,open) LONG / max(stop,open) SHORT; favorable target gaps receive target only
risk.leverage: <=1x entry notional accounting; no margin-return amplification, compounding, borrowing, liquidation profit or martingale
risk.liquidity: entry notional <=0.001*preceding completed minute quote volume; zero volume/stale/missing bars deny fill
risk.maker: no maker orders, no guaranteed limit fills; target executions also taker
risk.positions: one open trade per symbol per strategy; no new signal until preceding exit end; at most three asset positions
risk.precision: fresh Decimal Context(prec=28,ROUND_HALF_EVEN), derived strings quantized 12 decimals; no ambient precision dependency
risk.stop: fixed raw entry +/-1.5 ATR; entry fee/spread/slippage charged separately
risk.timeout: last minute close after exact 4h/12h max hold

source_admission_attempt_failed_before_c: initial funding decoder incorrectly assumed price-minute alignment; corrected to preserve publisher calculation clock, never alter candidate parameters or funding threshold
stale_exit: zero-volume open path hard-stops, no invented stop/target fill
